verdict.rationale: Brex's AI page says its assistants can file reimbursements for employees automatically, which confirms a first-party reimbursement flow exists. Nothing describes how an employee submits an out-of-pocket expense, how the payout is made, or how fast it arrives. The receipt-upload API matches receipts to existing expenses rather than creating out-of-pocket claims. Missing for 10: documented employee out-of-pocket submission flow, reimbursement payout by direct deposit, payout timing (days), status tracking from submission to payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
